shape.text: Cloudflare documents cfut_ as the scannable API token format. Its token-formats page says every prefixed token has a distinct prefix followed by 40 characters and a checksum.
Because Cloudflare says a checksum follows the 40-character body, a bare cfut_ followed by only 40 characters is malformed under the documented format. No checksum algorithm is computed or claimed.
The body is alphanumeric and the checksum is 8 lowercase hexadecimal characters, 53 characters in all.

unresolved.reason: Cloudflare says only that a checksum follows the body, and its token-formats page (last updated 2026-04-20) publishes no width or alphabet; the 8 lowercase hexadecimal characters come from one scanner rule.

issuance.text: No Cloudflare token was issued or observed for this record.

collisions.text: cfat_ (account-owned token) and cfk_ (scannable global key) share the same format cell of 40 characters and a checksum, and are separate credentials.

unresolved.reason: These formats are documented on other Cloudflare pages that are not recorded as sources of this family, and no tool corroborates the cfk_ checksum shape.

collisions.text: The older formats, a 40-character alphanumeric token and a 37 to 45 character hexadecimal global key, have no prefix and cannot be told from ordinary opaque values.

unresolved.reason: The older formats are described in the research overview; no source recorded for this family states them.
